lines.en: I cross the red rock of the badlands.
Grit crunches under my feet.
My head rides low, my shoulders high.
I follow a dry riverbed.

lines.zh: 我的影子在红土上很长
lines.en: My shadow stretches long on red earth.
I skirt a stone pillar.
My teeth show outside my jaw.
I tramp across the red sandstone.
Wind blows sand to my feet.
I stop and sniff the air.
Heat makes the distance shimmer.
I set off walking again.
My tail drags a line in the sand.

lines.zh: 这片恶地没有多少遮挡
lines.en: There's little cover in these badlands.
I stand in a pillar's shade.
My breathing is slow and deep.

lines.zh: 我在恶地的岩影里磨牙。
lines.en: I whet my teeth in the badland's rock shadow.
My teeth click when I close them.
The wind here is dry.

lines.zh: 我把头偏向峡谷的响动。
lines.en: I tilt my head toward the canyon noise.
A line of dust far off.
Sand has settled on my hide.
I settle down, then rise.
There's no water in this stretch.
My eyes are half shut.

lines.zh: 风一停，就只剩我的呼吸
lines.en: When the wind stops, only my breath.

lines.zh: 我在听石头那边的动静
lines.en: I listen past the stones.
Something is moving.
I look at you from behind a pillar.

lines.zh: 你站在红岩中间，很显眼
lines.en: Among the red rocks you stand out.

lines.zh: 恶地的石头，挡不住我这口牙。
lines.en: Badland stone cannot stop these teeth.
There are no trees to hide behind.
You can't retreat far.

lines.zh: 我踏上红岩，影子压过来。
lines.en: I step onto the red rock, my shadow pressing close.
Sand scatters under my feet.
You didn't run. Good.
Running would only make you clearer.
There's only wind between us.
I lower my head to your level.
I'm ready to charge.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩头，牙响了一声
lines.en: I shake my head; my teeth click.
A strip of hide peels back.
Blood dries fast in the sand.
I give half a step and lower my head.
A growl comes from my throat.
Sand scatters under me.
That has made me fiercer.
That blow had weight.
But I'm not down yet.
Then let me bite again.
That's not enough for me.
You hold it up in the hot wind.

lines.zh: 这片红土里少见这味道
lines.en: That smell is rare in this red dirt.
Set it down and I'll look.
I eat a lot and I'm not picky.
This thing is a bit too dry.
I sniff it. Not keen.
Step back two paces first.

lines.zh: 我还是想要你手里的手
lines.en: I still want the hand holding it.
Do not put it away yet; I have not looked.
You hit me and bounce off.
My breastbone knocks you back.
That throws up sand.
I shift half a step sideways.
I lower my head, teeth before you.
You pull back; I turn with you.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在你腿上扫过
lines.en: My tail sweeps your leg.
A red line of blood in the sand.
I crush a slab of sandstone.
Hit me again and I bite.
These badlands are enough for two.
I'll take the front; you take the flank.
Prey is scarce here.
So we watch in different directions.
In strong wind, don't split up.
The pillars block the wind.
Night falls cold, quickly.
Press close. I run hot.
Tomorrow we go lower.
There may be water there.
I take it up in my jaws.
This is too hard to crunch.
In the badlands, my teeth are shark-like.
This isn't meat.
You dropped it in the sand.
I flick the bone aside with my snout.

lines.zh: 这块矿石，填不了我的肚子。
lines.en: This ore will not fill my belly.
Keep it. I couldn't eat it.
One taste and I spit it out.
Sand tastes better.
You're ahead of me now.
I lower my body and charge.
This flat ground suits a run.
You can't outrun four legs.
My teeth grew for this.

lines.zh: 你一动，我的头就转过去。
lines.en: You move, and my head swings after you.
Sand will drag at your feet.
I've picked the point of impact.
You have a few steps of running left.
Then it's sand.
I've quickened my pace.
Wind roars past my ears.
You looked back at me.
Then it's too late.
I hold this speed.

lines.zh: 我头很低，肩很高，跟着你。
lines.en: Head low, shoulders high, I follow you.
You run around the pillars.
A pillar catches me once.
But I come out again.

lines.zh: 你的脚步越来越重，恶地的沙在滑。
lines.en: Your steps grow heavy; the badlands sand slips.
You can't run well in sand.
I know you're tiring.
One more bite will do.
I've closed the distance.
Your shadow is before me.
My jaws are opening.
Listen. I'm right behind.
That breathing is mine.
One last step to go.
Now. One bite.
Shut your mouth. Don't shout.
My teeth clamp your shoulder.

lines.zh: 这一撞把你掀翻在沙里
lines.en: This charge flips you into the sand.
I shake my head and drag you a step.

lines.zh: 你的护甲在我的牙间响
lines.en: Your armour creaks between my teeth.
My claw pins your chest.
Sand is in your eyes.
That bite missed.
But you fell back and I press in.
My breath is on your face.
You raise an arm. It won't hold.
More red lines in the sand.
You can last one more.
Then that's enough.
I drop my head low.
This time it's the throat.
Let it end here.
I step out from behind a pillar.
Badland heat hugs the ground.
Only two came this time.

lines.zh: 我的影子在红岩上很黑
lines.en: My shadow is black on the red rock.

lines.zh: 热风从峡谷来，我嗅了嗅。
lines.en: Hot wind rises from the canyon; I sniff it.

lines.zh: 没有水，也没有多少猎物
lines.en: No water, and little prey.
But I can afford to wait.
My teeth show outside my jaw.
I walk slowly into the open.
My steps echo off the rocks.
Something's in the sand ahead.

lines.zh: 恶地的红土，磨亮了我的牙。
lines.en: Badland red dust has polished my teeth.
Wind pushes the sand along.
I follow the smell.
Very, very close now.
I stop in my tracks.
The fire hardens my hide.
I crash into the sand, throwing up a cloud.
Water fills my throat; I thrash.
The blast throws me against a pillar.

lines.zh: 恶地的鲨齿，二十点一口。
lines.en: A badlands shark-tooth, twenty per bite.
That light buckles my legs.
Too starved to manage a charge.
Lightning hits the red rock and I lock up.
No sand below. I drop.
